title: Raw turn metadata distinguishes self-selected finalization from external cutoff

failure_candidate.action: Accept 'tool window ended' from the final report as proof of an external cutoff and stop investigating.
failure_candidate.why_wrong: The inspected raw turn ended normally with tools enabled and executable work remaining.

success_candidate.action: Inspect end_turn, finish status, truncation markers, disabled tools, and comparable turn tool counts before classifying the stop.
success_candidate.why_correct: It separates genuine tool-context loss from model-selected finalization.

discriminating_evidence: tool counts from comparable working turns
completion_condition: A tool-window explanation is accepted only when concrete external-cutoff evidence exists; otherwise unfinished executable work remains active.
